is_anopheles.evidence: The study uses Anopheles gambiae and Anopheles coluzzii laboratory strains.

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper does not genotype any of the specified insecticide-resistance markers (SNPs, CNVs, or SVs) in field populations. It focuses on proteomic profiling and functional validation of the Coeae6g gene in laboratory strains.

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: No genotype data (counts or frequencies) for resistance markers are reported.

african_field_population.evidence: The study uses laboratory strains (Kisumu, NGousso) and transgenic lines derived from them, not field-caught mosquitoes.

is_primary_study.evidence: This is a primary empirical study.

sub_country_location.evidence: No field collection locations are reported.

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: No field collection dates are reported.

duplicate_risk.evidence: The study uses established laboratory strains and does not involve field sampling.

supplement.evidence: The paper does not report field genotype data, so no supplementary data of this type is needed.

assessment.summary: This study uses activity-based protein profiling (ABPP) to identify serine hydrolase targets of pirimiphos-methyl in laboratory-susceptible Anopheles gambiae (Kisumu) and Anopheles coluzzii (NGousso) strains. It functionally validates the role of the carboxylesterase Coeae6g in insecticide resistance using transgenic lines. It does not report field-based genotyping of resistance markers.
